tool.name: emit_artifacts
tool.description: Return the dense reward function and the episode-configuration sampler, as two complete standalone Python modules, plus your reasoning. This is the only way to deliver the answer, and it is called ONCE - there is no follow-up turn in which to fill a field in. Every field must contain its final content. A field whose value is 'placeholder' or 'x' becomes a file with that as its entire contents.

reward_py.description: The complete contents of reward.py: module-level REWARD_MAX and a compute_reward(env, obs, action, info) function. Raw Python source, no markdown fences.

sampler_py.description: The complete contents of sampler.py: a sample_cube_poses(b, device) function. Raw Python source, no markdown fences.

rationale.description: Markdown. Why each term is there, which mechanism from the video and the description it addresses, and the explicit stage ladder with the numeric band each stage occupies.

uncertainties.description: Markdown. What you are least sure of, which term you expect an optimiser to exploit first, and what you predict validation will find.
